info.name: DigifyHR Payroll APIs — Complete
info.description:
Complete DigifyHR Payroll REST API collection (Oracle PAY + TM → PAY).

Folders: 01–25 | Requests: 308

Includes:
- Elements, formulas, balances, eligibility, recurring
- Payroll runs, entries, retro, arrears
- Payments, GL, payslips, period close, approvals
- Statutory, operations, health, certification
- Dashboard & audit
- NEW: TM Payroll Source Mappings (22)
- NEW: Hourly Rate Policies (23)
- NEW: TM Payroll Transfer (24)
- NEW: Remaining Payroll Configuration (25)

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/api/payroll
Auth: Bearer {{jwt}}

Set variables: baseUrl, jwt, enterprise_id, payroll_id, run_id,
hourly_rate_policy_id, payroll_source_mapping_id, transfer_batch_id, transfer_line_id
